verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's Query Assistant turns natural-language input into queries (AI-generated), and its documented MCP server explicitly lets connected AI agents 'identify performance outliers and suggest optimization opportunities' and 'diagnose latency or error spikes' using live Honeycomb data, which is a form of AI-generated insight surfaced via the product's own data. However, these insights largely depend on an external AI agent via MCP rather than a fully native in-product insight engine, and BubbleUp (mentioned only as a pricing checkmark) is not described as AI-driven. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of a native, always-on AI insight/anomaly-detection feature independent of MCP, and hands-on evidence of its output quality.
